hey @*reflectors* , during working with reflector I had a bunch of frustrations about observability and retryability/performance of the pipelines so went forward with researching existing solutions in industry

the most well known being durable workflow [pattern?] that most of you may already know from Temporal io implementation

main problems were: 

- retries go forever (20min for an integration testing loop easily) - impacts both users (they wait for reprocessing forever) and devs (have to isolate code in order to test, and even isolated, integration test has to be done anyways)
- it's difficult to see which step the process on, what are the steps, how many steps left, how long left, which step has an error and what error - again, impact both users and devex, but ALSO impacts "power users" - the devops/developers who will be installing reflector on their premises, AND also impacts potential contributors
- it's unclear, without good Reflector knowledge and without analyzing the code, what steps are performed at all - fixed partially with docs but docs is not the format that is easily maintainable :smile: and will fall behind

durable workflow is a potential solution (and I believe that the easiest/most well-established in industry) to the problems above 

I no-mistaked a flow in one of durable workflow self-hosted solutions (postgres based) to demo the approach and it already runs daily co diarizations for me

[Screenshot 2025-12-15 at 11.33.39 AM.png](/user_uploads/4/fb/Z-cFIRtMV_VivACB4yIeKNhs/Screenshot-2025-12-15-at-11.33.39AM.png)

potential solution https://www.loom.com/share/d0a2c82311c24b80b691d1a5b619bb39

What do you think? Probably we can have a separate call to speak about it - consider the videos above a prep then (5min + 5min)
